control_settings.description: General control settings for this tool

aircraft_exchange_file_name.description: Specify the name of the exchange file

aircraft_exchange_file_directory.description: Specify the direction in which the aircraft exchange file can be found

own_tool_level.description: Specify the tool level of this tool

console_output.description: Selector to specify the console output. Selector: mode_0 (Off) / mode_1 (only out/err/warn), mode_2 (1 + info) / mode_3 (2 + debug)

log_file_output.description: Selector to specify the log file output. Selector: mode_0 (Off) / mode_1 (only out/err/warn), mode_2 (1 + info) / mode_3 (2 + debug)

plot_output.description: Specify the way plotting shall be handled

enable.description: Switch to enable plotting. Switch: true (On) / false (Off)

copy_plotting_files.description: Switch if plotting files shall be copied. Switch: true (On) / false (Off)

delete_plotting_files_from_tool_folder.description: Switch if plotting files shall be deleted from folder. Switch: true (On) / false (Off)

report_output.description: Switch to generate an HTML report. Switch: true (On) / false (Off)

tex_report.description: Switch to generate a Tex report. Switch: true (On) / false (Off)

write_info_files.description: Switch to generate info files. Switch: true (On) / false (Off)

log_file.description: Specify the name of the log file

inkscape_path.description: Path to inkscape (only needed if your executable is not part of system paths - otherwise unused)

gnuplot_path.description: Path to gnuplot (only needed if your executable is not part of system paths - otherwise unused)

specific_air_range_plot.description: Switch to generate plots for the specific air range. Switch: true (On) / false (Off)

exit_if_fuel_limit_reached.description: Switch to abort program if estimated fuel reaches maximum fuel mass.

allowed_relative_overshoot.description: Relative overshoot that shall be allowed

exit_if_maximum_takeoff_mass_limit_reach.description: Switch to abort program in study mode if takeoff mass (TOM) is greater than/equal to maximum takoff mass (MTOM).

allowed_relative_overshoot.description: Relative overshoot that shall be allowed

fuel_planning.description: Fuel planning according to the Joint Aviation Requirements (JAR) or the Federal Aviation Regulations (FAR)

fuel_estimation_switch.description: (Trip fuel only) Switch if the fuel estimation method within the aircraft XML shall be used (to be found in the mission requirements' fuel_estimation_selector). Switch: true (On) / false (Off)

joint_aviation_requirements_parameters.description: Parameter for fuel planning according to the Joint Aviation Requirements (JAR)

contingency_fuel.description: Relative share of contingency fuel in total trip fuel. Standard: 0.05., with en-route allowance: 0.03 (check 'Getting to Grips With Aircraft Performance' p.173)

use_additional_fuel.description: Switch if additional fuel shall be added e.g. for flag or supplemental operations. Switch: true (On) / false (Off)

extra_fuel.description: Extra fuel that shall be carried at the discretion of the captain

federal_aviation_regulations_parameter.description: Parameter for fuel planning according to the Federal Aviation Regulations (FAR)

use_additional_fuel.description: Switch if additional fuel shall be added e.g. for flag or supplemental operations. Switch: true (On) / false (Off)

fuel_flow_factor_taxiing.description: Factor to adapt the (idle) fuel flow during taxiing

holding_altitude.description: Altitude during holding (30.48 m = 100 ft = 1 FL)

use_economical_speed.description: Switch if the economic Mach number shall overwrite the holding Mach number within the value node. Switch: true (On) / false (Off)

increase_engine_rating_during_climb.description: Switch to set engine rating to maximum continuous during climb if climb rating is not sufficient. Switch: true (On) / false (Off)

allow_minimum_roc_violation.description: Switch to allow minimum ROC violation during climb. Will terminate climb step otherwise. Switch: true (On) / false (Off)

maximum_air_brake_factor.description: Maximum multiplier to increase drag using air_brakes (D_needed = D * air_brake_factor, with air_brake_factor smaller than maximum_air_brake_factor)

polar_switch_mission_point.description: Definition where and how a polar switch shall take place

polar_switch_selector.description: Selector to define the mission point where alternative polars takes place ('mode_0': Off, 'mode_1': Absolute range, 'mode_2': Relative range, 'mode_3'': Absolute remaining flight time, 'mode_4': Relative remaining flight time)

relative_range_flown.description: Range flown relative to total range

relative_time_passed.description: Passed flight time relative to the total flight time

glide_slope_interception_distance.description: Buffer distance to hit the glide slope exactly

use_breguet_estimation_in_cruise.description: Switch to activate fuel estimation using Breguet range equation in mid fidelity methods. Switch: true (On) / false (Off)

iterate_top_of_descent_mass.description: Switch for iteration of mass at top of descent. Switch: true (On) / false (Off)

rotation_time.description: Time to rotate at touch down from main gear to nose gear

enable.description: Switch to use thrust reverser for deceleration. Switch: true (On) / false (Off)

deactivation_speed.description: Calibrated airspeed when the thrust reverser is set from Maximum to Idle

runway_exit_speed.description: Speed to slow down until runway can be exited (normal exit A320: max 15 kts = 7.72 m/s; high speed exit A320: max 25 kts = 12.86 m/s)

fidelity_level.description: Selector to set a standard 3D or 4D trajectory. Selector: low (Breguet-based estimation for fuel consumption only) / mid (3D high resolution mission profile) / high (4D high resolution mission profile)

mission_type.description: Selector to set the mission type. Selector: design_mission / study_mission / requirements_mission)

interpolate_polars.description: Switch to interpolate polars in respect to the center of gravity position. Switch: true (On) / false (off)

rate_of_climb_switch.description: Switch THAT ONLY AFFECTS THE REQUIREMENTS MISSION. Calculate an optimum for the rate of climb. Switch: true (calculate optimum) / false (skip)

acceleration_increment.description: Step size regarding acceleration or deceleration

mach_acceleration_increment.description: Step size regarding acceleration or deceleration as a Mach number

altitude_increment.description: Step distance for climb or descent

specific_air_range_check_increment.description: Relative step distance in x-direction for automatic Flight level change check
